questions.prompt: Find the coefficient of $x^{5}$ in $(2-x)^{8}$.

questions.title: Five digit numbers above forty thousand
questions.prompt: How many five-digit numbers greater than $40\,000$ can be formed from the digits $1,2,3,4,5,6$ without repetition?

questions.title: Weighted sum of binomial coefficients
questions.prompt: By substituting a suitable value of $x$ into $(1+x)^{8}$, evaluate $\displaystyle\sum_{k=0}^{8}\binom8k2^{k}$.

questions.title: Letters of SYDNEY with the Ys apart
questions.prompt: How many arrangements of the letters of SYDNEY have the two Ys not next to each other?

questions.title: Constant term with halves and twos
questions.prompt: Find the term independent of $x$ in $\left(\dfrac x2-\dfrac2x\right)^{10}$.

questions.title: Six beads on a bracelet
questions.prompt: How many different bracelets can be made from $6$ different beads, if a bracelet can be turned over?

questions.title: Captain vice captain and three others
questions.prompt: From $12$ players, a captain, a vice-captain and $3$ other team members are chosen. How many selections are possible?

questions.title: Three couples sitting together in a row
questions.prompt: Three couples sit in a row of six chairs so that each couple sits together. How many arrangements are possible?
hints: Treat each couple as a block.

ladder.nudge: Treat each couple as a block.

questions.title: Poker hands with exactly two aces
questions.prompt: How many $5$-card hands from a standard $52$-card deck contain exactly two aces?

questions.title: Sum of even-indexed binomial coefficients
questions.prompt: By substituting $x=1$ and $x=-1$ in $(1+x)^{9}$, find $\binom90+\binom92+\binom94+\binom96+\binom98$.

questions.title: Arrangements of PARRAMATTA
questions.prompt: How many distinct arrangements are there of the letters of PARRAMATTA?

questions.title: Committee with more girls than boys
questions.prompt: A committee of $6$ is chosen from $7$ boys and $5$ girls. How many committees have more girls than boys?

questions.title: EQUATION with vowels in alphabetical order
questions.prompt: How many arrangements of the letters of EQUATION have the vowels in alphabetical order (A, E, I, O, U) from left to right?

questions.title: Ana refuses to sit beside Ben
questions.prompt: Six friends sit around a circular table. Ana refuses to sit beside Ben. How many seating plans are there?

questions.title: Choosing four when two people refuse to serve together
questions.prompt: Four people are chosen from $10$. Two of the ten refuse to be chosen together. How many selections are possible?

questions.title: Term in x to the seventh with a negative square power
questions.prompt: Find the coefficient of $x^{7}$ in $\left(2x-\dfrac1{x^{2}}\right)^{10}$.

questions.title: Three digit numbers with strictly increasing digits
questions.prompt: How many three-digit numbers have digits that strictly increase from left to right?
hints: Each choice has one increasing order.

ladder.method: Each choice has one increasing order.

steps.d: Any $3$ of the digits $1$ to $9$ in one order

questions.title: BANANA with no two As together
questions.prompt: How many arrangements of BANANA have no two As next to each other?

steps.d: Choose $3$ of $4$ gaps for the As: $4$

questions.title: Three numbers from one to twenty with an even sum
questions.prompt: Three different numbers are chosen from $1,2,\dots,20$. How many choices have an even sum?
hints: Even sum needs an even number of odds.

ladder.nudge: Even sum needs an even number of odds.

steps.d: Three even: $\binom{10}3=120$; two odd one even: $\binom{10}2\times10=450$

questions.title: Coefficient of x^5 in (1 - 3x)^7
questions.prompt: Find the coefficient of $x^{5}$ in $(1-3x)^{7}$.

questions.title: Four letter words from MATHS containing the A
questions.prompt: How many $4$-letter arrangements of distinct letters chosen from MATHS contain the letter A?

questions.title: Two chessboard squares sharing no row or column
questions.prompt: In how many ways can two squares of an $8\times8$ chessboard be chosen so that they are in different rows and different columns?

questions.title: Equal adjacent coefficients in one plus x to the n
questions.prompt: In the expansion of $(1+x)^{n}$, the coefficients of $x^{4}$ and $x^{5}$ are equal. Find $n$.

questions.title: Maths books not all together
questions.prompt: Three different maths, two different English and two different science books are placed on a shelf. In how many arrangements are the three maths books not all together?

questions.title: Team including at least one of two stars
questions.prompt: A team of $4$ is chosen from $9$ players. How many teams include at least one of the two best players?

questions.title: Coefficient of x squared in a sum of powers
questions.prompt: Find the coefficient of $x^{2}$ in $(1+x)^{3}+(1+x)^{4}+\cdots+(1+x)^{10}$, using the identity $\displaystyle\sum_{k=2}^{n}\binom k2=\binom{n+1}3$.
hints: Coefficient in each term is C(k, 2).

ladder.nudge: Coefficient in each term is C(k, 2).

questions.title: Boys and girls alternating at a round table
questions.prompt: Four boys and four girls sit at a round table so that boys and girls alternate. How many arrangements are possible?

questions.title: Triples with sum divisible by three
questions.prompt: In how many ways can three different numbers be chosen from $1,2,\dots,20$ so that their sum is divisible by $3$?
hints: Sort the numbers by remainder mod 3.
Which remainder patterns sum to a multiple of 3?

ladder.nudge: Sort the numbers by remainder mod 3.
ladder.method: Which remainder patterns sum to a multiple of 3?

steps.d: All same remainder, or one of each remainder

traps.why: Counted only one number from each remainder class.
